correctness.rationale: The Fourier kernel gives an exact H1 periodic energy. The variational spline/bubble Euler equation implies w_j=H_j-D uniformly in j. Strictly nonnegative Fourier-hat multipliers against nonpositive cosine coefficients of the sine density imply H_j>=H_0. Direct endpoint integral H_0 and bubble Fourier coefficients give exact parity-dependent B_N. B_N>1/(12N²) and H_0<=1/N certify a positive denominator. The equality and sign follow exactly, for every N and gamma. Series/Taylor calculations give Gamma_N=N+pi²/3+O(1/N). The stand-alone script cross-checks 44 finite cases by an independently assembled Gram system; it is not used for the all-N assertion.

value.rationale: The parameter is the natural smoothness/kernel scale in a recent one-dimensional baseline of a multivariate integration method. The finding resolves a complete sharp necessary-and-sufficient positivity classification for all full lattice sizes, with closed parity branches and a nontrivial linear asymptotic threshold. Negative endpoint weights are consequential because exact integration of nonnegative data can fail, while eventual positivity for fixed gamma supplies a usable rigorous design guarantee. The result is not an arbitrary single finite case or a routine renormalization.
